personalInfo.title: Full Stack Web Developer
personalInfo.profile: Accomplished Full Stack Web Developer with 3+ years of progressive experience specializing in high-impact frontend architecture, robust full-stack integration, and AI-driven engineering. Expert at leveraging Claude Code, Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG, and Specification-Driven Development (SDD) alongside runtime environments like Bun and Antigravity frameworks to accelerate software delivery. Driven by Clean Code principles, SOLID architecture, and optimal user experience (UX) to build highly scalable, intelligent, and performance-optimized web applications within Agile SCRUM environments.

responsibilities: Successfully created and launched over 50 fully responsive websites from provided design specifications, applying Clean Code standards to guarantee structural maintenance and optimal cross-device UX.
Led the content migration process from legacy client websites, utilizing Python, Bun-driven scripts, and Claude Code agentic workflows to automate operations and guarantee data integrity.
Developed multiple internal tools and custom AI prompt chains that significantly streamlined the site styling process, resulting in a marked increase in frontend development efficiency.
Supported the project's planning and roadmap execution by applying Specification-Driven Development (SDD) to establish reliable, predictable full-stack behaviors.
Enhanced user satisfaction and performance by optimizing Nuxt components, enforcing SOLID principles, and utilizing AI-augmented linting to minimize technical debt.

Played a key role in delivering an intelligent microservice architecture, implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Antigravity deployment structures, and RAG pipelines to connect application backends with LLM layers.
Facilitated data exchange and integration by designing, implementing, and consuming REST APIs structured around clear Clean Architecture guidelines.
Accelerated project completion across multiple technology stacks, utilizing modern database optimizations and automated testing workflows to ensure systemic reliability.
Contributed to the successful launch and maintenance of multiple web applications by planning, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining features, ensuring high availability.
